chain.label: Rudder post originally specified in AISI 1025 carbon steel
chain.trigger: the rudder post for part number 40622 was originally manufactured from 0.875-inch diameter, 0.035-inch wall thickness AISI 1025 carbon steel tube

chain.label: AISI 1025 rudder posts susceptible to fatigue cracking under normal service, worsened by surface corrosion/scratches
chain.trigger: posts made of AISI 1025 carbon steel in Piper part number 40622 rudders are susceptible to fatigue cracking under normal service conditions

caused_by.evidence: the peak stresses on the nominal rudder post approach the endurance limit of AISI 1025 steel

chain.label: Rudder post fatigue fracture above upper hinge; rudder top folded over tail brace wires
chain.trigger: the rudder post fractured above the upper hinge and the top portion of the rudder folded over the upper tail brace wires

caused_by.evidence: the fatigue fracture of the AISI 1025 carbon steel rudder post, which resulted in structural failure of the rudder

chain.label: Diminished yaw control requiring compensating elevator and rudder inputs
chain.trigger: noticed drastically diminished control about the vertical axis

caused_by.evidence: resulting in diminished control of the airplane

chain.label: Pilots retained enough control to land safely; airplanes sustained substantial damage, no injuries
chain.trigger: he was able to land the airplane without further incident
